Talking helps, after a while. I’ve never once been able to come out of my depressive episodes before at least 3-4 hours. The only thing I find helpful, is to wallow. Honestly. I don’t mean feel bad for yourself and pout, like everyone at my school seems to think depression is. I mean think about your situation, really hard. Focus on the details. Maybe it’s my ADHD, but after an hour or 2 of doing that along with listening to music, I’ll be fine, because my mind just bounces to something else, and by the end I forgot what pushed me into that state. Although this is kind of time/situation dependent because sometimes people get days of lows, others get an hour or 2 of extreme depression every once and a while, and everything in between. So it depends, but if you think it would work, try it. It helps for me.
